titleEn: Find Closest Node to Given Two Nodes
title: 找到离给定两个节点最近的节点
summary: 每个节点至多一条出边，找一个能被 node1 和 node2 都到达且两者距离最大值最小的节点，并列取下标最小。
insight: 沿唯一出边分别从两个起点走，记录首次到达距离，遇已访问或负一停止。随后按下标扫描共同可达节点并比较 max(dist1,dist2)。
pitfalls: 目标必须从两个起点都可达

solutions.title: 两条函数图路径距离
solutions.idea: 唯一出边使每个起点只需线性追踪一次。
steps: distance(start) 初始化 -1，沿 edges 记录递增步数直到终止或重复
从下标零开始扫描两者均非负的位置
更小 maximumDistance 时更新答案；顺序扫描自然保留最小下标

code.java: class Solution { private int[] distances(int[] edges,int start){int[] distance=new int[edges.length];Arrays.fill(distance,-1);for(int steps=0;start!=-1&&distance[start]==-1;steps++){distance[start]=steps;start=edges[start];}return distance;}public int closestMeetingNode(int[] edges,int node1,int node2){int[] first=distances(edges,node1),second=distances(edges,node2);int answer=-1,best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int i=0;i<edges.length;i++)if(first[i]>=0&&second[i]>=0&&Math.max(first[i],second[i])<best){best=Math.max(first[i],second[i]);answer=i;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun distances(edges:IntArray,startValue:Int):IntArray{val distance=IntArray(edges.size){-1};var node=startValue;var steps=0;while(node!=-1&&distance[node]==-1){distance[node]=steps++;node=edges[node]};return distance};fun closestMeetingNode(edges:IntArray,node1:Int,node2:Int):Int{val first=distances(edges,node1);val second=distances(edges,node2);var answer=-1;var best=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(i in edges.indices)if(first[i]>=0&&second[i]>=0&&maxOf(first[i],second[i])<best){best=maxOf(first[i],second[i]);answer=i};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> distances(vector<int>& edges,int node){vector<int> distance(edges.size(),-1);for(int steps=0;node!=-1&&distance[node]==-1;++steps){distance[node]=steps;node=edges[node];}return distance;}public:int closestMeetingNode(vector<int>& edges,int node1,int node2){auto first=distances(edges,node1),second=distances(edges,node2);int answer=-1,best=INT_MAX;for(int i=0;i<(int)edges.size();++i)if(first[i]>=0&&second[i]>=0&&max(first[i],second[i])<best){best=max(first[i],second[i]);answer=i;}return answer;} };
